"""Repeat fixed residual diagnostics on disjoint, preassigned dark pairs."""
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess

import numpy as np

from analysis.render import available_memory, runtime_env
from measure_noise_opening_stages import read_crops
from study_noise_profile_decomposition import same_profile_context
from study_noise_residual_distributions import describe,pack_cfa
from study_noise_neighbourhoods import ROOT,sha256,git


def disjoint_pairs(indices):
    values=list(indices)
    if len(set(values))!=len(values) or any(not isinstance(i,int) or i<0 for i in values):
        raise ValueError('Distinct nonnegative indices required')
    return [values[i:i+2] for i in range(0,len(values)-1,2)], values[-1:] if len(values)%2 else []


def run():
    started=datetime.now(timezone.utc);stamp=started.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ');base=ROOT/'docs/validation/raw'
    names=('qualification-noirs-repetes-bruit-v001-20261028T100350Z.json',
           'sonde-etapes-ouverture-bruit-v001-20261028T104746Z.json',
           'distributions-residus-bruit-v001-20261028T113008Z.json')
    paths=[base/n for n in names];hashes=[sha256(p) for p in paths]
    blacks,pilot,prior=[json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')) for p in paths]
    black_freeze=Path(blacks['freeze']['path'])
    if sha256(black_freeze)!=blacks['freeze']['sha256']:raise ValueError('Original allocation changed')
    groups=json.loads(black_freeze.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))['groups']
    pairs=[];omitted=[];identities={}
    for g in groups:
        if g['iso'] not in (1600,51200):continue
        for subset in ('development','control'):
            selected,leftover=disjoint_pairs(g[subset])
            omitted.extend(dict(iso=g['iso'],subset=subset,path=g['frames'][i]['path'],reason='unpaired_original_allocation') for i in leftover)
            for indices in selected:
                frames=[g['frames'][i] for i in indices]
                pair=dict(iso=g['iso'],subset=subset,paths=[f['path'] for f in frames],indices=indices)
                pairs.append(pair)
                identities.update({f['path']:f['sha256'] for f in frames})
    if len(pairs)!=10 or len(identities)!=20:raise ValueError('Unexpected frozen coverage')
    tool=ROOT/'build-patch_noise/burst-tools/Release/iprOpeningTransportProbe.exe';tool_hash=sha256(tool)
    freeze=base/f'gel-repetabilite-distributions-noirs-v001-{stamp}.json'
    frozen=dict(campaign_id='noise-dark-distributions-repeatability-freeze-'+stamp,schema_version=1,data_version=1,measured_at_utc=started.isoformat(),
        parents=[dict(path=str(p),sha256=h) for p,h in zip(paths,hashes)],pairs=pairs,omitted=omitted,source_sha256=identities,
        original_allocation=dict(path=str(black_freeze),sha256=sha256(black_freeze)),tool=dict(path=str(tool),sha256=tool_hash),
        policy='All disjoint adjacent pairs WITHIN original development/control allocations at ISO1600/51200.10 pairs,20 frames; odd leftovers omitted, never cross subset boundaries. Three center128 ROIs, same fixed metrics as previous distribution audit. Reuse4 existing pilot native frames after identity checks; decode16 others via exact-production guarded probe, sequentially. Compare to frozen original simulations, no new model fit, threshold tuning, final42-burst reserve access or production modification. Control frames previously inspected for raw variance; internal repeatability, not pristine blind validation.',
        runner_source=Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8'),runner_sha256=sha256(Path(__file__)))
    with freeze.open('x',encoding='utf-8') as h:json.dump(frozen,h,ensure_ascii=False,indent=1,allow_nan=False)
    print('FROZEN',freeze,flush=True)
    work=ROOT/'build-patch_noise/dark-distribution-repeatability'/stamp;work.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
    native={}
    for index,(source,identity) in enumerate(identities.items()):
        if source in pilot['native']:
            item=pilot['native'][source]
            if item['record']['source_sha256']!=identity or sha256(Path(item['path']))!=item['sha256'] or sha256(Path(item['pixels']['path']))!=item['pixels']['sha256']:
                raise ValueError('Cached pilot changed')
            native[source]=item;print('REUSED',Path(source).name,flush=True);continue
        if (available_memory() or 0)<7*1024**3:raise ValueError('Need7GiB available before native decode')
        path=Path(source)
        if sha256(path)!=identity:raise ValueError('Dark source changed')
        out=work/f'{index:02}-{path.stem}.json'
        subprocess.run([str(tool),str(out),source],check=True,env=runtime_env(tool),timeout=240)
        record=json.loads(out.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
        if record['source_sha256']!=identity or record['camera_baseline_delta']>1e-7 or record['master_baseline_delta']>1e-7:
            raise ValueError('Native baseline or identity failed')
        native[source]=dict(path=str(out),sha256=sha256(out),record=record,pixels=dict(path=str(out)+'.f32',sha256=sha256(Path(str(out)+'.f32'))))
        print('DECODED',index+1,'/',len(identities),path.name,flush=True)
    simulations={(r['iso'],r['roi']):r for r in prior['records']};records=[]
    for pi,pair in enumerate(pairs):
        a,b=[native[p] for p in pair['paths']]
        crops=[read_crops(Path(i['pixels']['path']),i['record']) for i in (a,b)]
        context=same_profile_context(a['record'],b['record'])
        for roi in range(3):
            stages={}
            for stage in ('pre_rcd_scaled_cfa','post_rcd_median_camera_rgb','pre_dcp_camera_rgb','post_dcp_rec2020'):
                values=[v[stage][roi][64:192,64:192] for v in crops]
                if stage=='pre_rcd_scaled_cfa':values=[pack_cfa(v) for v in values]
                stats=describe(*values)
                sim=simulations[(pair['iso'],roi)]['stages'][stage]
                stages[stage]=dict(real=stats,simulation_reference_case=simulations[(pair['iso'],roi)]['case_id'],
                    simulated_median_sigma=sim.get('simulated_median_sigma'),simulated_median_lags=sim.get('simulated_median_lags'),
                    simulated_median_excess_kurtosis=np.median([r['excess_kurtosis'] for r in sim['simulated_pairs']],axis=0).tolist() if 'simulated_pairs' in sim else None)
            records.append(dict(pair_index=pi,**pair,roi=roi,same_profile_context=context,
                gains=[i['record']['pre_interpolate_state'] for i in (a,b)],stages=stages))
        print('SCORED',pi+1,'/',len(pairs),pair['iso'],pair['subset'],flush=True)
    if hashes!=[sha256(p) for p in paths] or tool_hash!=sha256(tool):raise ValueError('Provenance changed')
    now=datetime.now(timezone.utc);out=base/f'repetabilite-distributions-noirs-v001-{now.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")}.json'
    result=dict(campaign_id='noise-dark-distributions-repeatability-'+stamp,schema_version=1,data_version=1,started_at_utc=started.isoformat(),measured_at_utc=now.isoformat(),completed_at_utc=now.isoformat(),
        parents=frozen['parents'],freeze=dict(path=str(freeze),sha256=sha256(freeze)),native=native,records=records,omitted=omitted,commit=git('rev-parse','HEAD'),
        units=prior['units'],metric_source_sha256=sha256(ROOT/'tests/study_noise_residual_distributions.py'),
        limitations='Same-session dark captures, repeated statistical inspection. Original control allocation preserved but raw moments already seen.10 disjoint pairs not30 independent acquisitions; three ROIs correlated within image. Simulation reference keeps first pilot context, later gains/WB/black may differ; compare descriptively, no exact prediction claim across changed contexts. Pair differences remove common patterns; kurtosis sensitive to rare outliers. No fit, visual denoise proof, final42-burst reserve access, production change or new acquisition request.',verdict='internal_dark_distribution_repeatability_not_blind_validation')
    with out.open('x',encoding='utf-8') as h:json.dump(result,h,ensure_ascii=False,indent=1,allow_nan=False)
    print('RESULT',out,flush=True)


if __name__=='__main__':run()
